summary: No Blocker. The Phase 14 code matches FR14-1 to FR14-3: sound-stages.ts is pure, reads no file and no Thai field, and holds the plan, the positions, the units, and the three rows. The schema field paStage is optional and strict, and an old week file without it still parses. The R14 rows run in the CLI after the readalong row, and all three pass for st2/1 to st2/8 in my run. The content matches the change list: my apply check prints rows applied 114, weeks equal 8 of 8, copies cmp equal 5 of 5, removed 5 of 5; my form check prints whitespace-only changes 0 for each week. The week files hold one paStage each and no final-sound or medial-vowel tag; the day-1 lines match the stage plan. The RED_TEST_COMMAND passes at HEAD: 4 files, 192 tests, exit 0. My missing-deliverable fixtures fail the rows as they should. Four Nits are open: the share compare has no English-only check, the mutant capture under-counts its own runs, the AC14-1 summary text differs from the printed line, and the test strategy has no Phase 14 section.
